The '''Imperial Domination Outpost''' was a military installation of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] located atop [[Vixxon's Shear]], an outcropping in the [[Alien Gangland]] region of the [[High Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]
